comment: Just not a good professor. She is nice, but she is not timely with grading. All the major assignments were graded at the very last minute. Her feedback isn't great when she gives it.  Class is literally just a headache, and nothing is clear or, honestly, fair. Take literally any other strategic professor. Good luck if you have a bad group.

One of the most frustrating classes I've taken at U of R. She makes everything subjective, so you really have no idea what the correct answer is half of the time. Doesn't even know the contents of her own textbook. Makes you do a case competition on a random Saturday at 9AM that lasts 6 hours. And good luck if you get a bad group!
